name: Zombie Horde (counter scaling, go-wide)
takesLocations: {enablers} grow the Zombie Horde all game; {payoffs} cash it in on turns 5 and 6 to win two lanes.

name: Tempo: many small On Reveals
takesLocations: {enablers} let you play two or more cards a turn; {payoffs} grow from it and land with other cards on turn 6.

name: Put-into-play burst
takesLocations: {enablers} put bodies such as {payoffs} into the other locations at once on the last turns.

name: Affliction and Power theft
takesLocations: {enablers} lower the enemy totals while {payoffs} turn the stolen or lost Power into lanes.

name: Shuffle-in and draw
takesLocations: {enablers} add strong cards to your deck; {payoffs} draw or repeat them on turns 5 and 6.

name: No-ability stats, go-tall
takesLocations: {enablers} put high printed Power or ability-less bodies on the board; {payoffs} multiply it on curve.

name: Disruption as the plan
takesLocations: {enablers} subtract more from the opponent than they cost; {payoffs} supply the Power to win the lanes they leave open.

name: Destroy scaling
takesLocations: {enablers} destroy your own cards for value; {payoffs} copy, grow or count the destroyed cards.

name: Location removal
takesLocations: {enablers} win one lane alone; {payoffs} then turns two of three locations into one of one.

name: Discard scaling
takesLocations: {enablers} discard as fuel; {payoffs} count the discards or come back stronger.

name: Ongoing stacking
takesLocations: {enablers} multiply or share one lane's total; {payoffs} repeat or copy the Ongoing effects to win a second lane.

name: Extra energy
takesLocations: {enablers} give more than 21 Energy over the game so {payoffs} land early or together.

name: Unspent energy
takesLocations: {enablers} leave Energy unspent or add bonus Energy; {payoffs} grow from it and hold a location while you play fewer cards.

name: Extra turn
takesLocations: {enablers} create a turn 7, when {payoffs} land after the opponent has run out of turns.

name: Move reallocation
takesLocations: {enablers} commit Power early and move it after the opponent commits; {payoffs} grow from the moves.

name: Lockdown
takesLocations: {payoffs} win a lane early, then {enablers} close it.

name: Last-turn hidden power
takesLocations: {enablers} hold Power off the board until turn 6, when {payoffs} decide the lanes too late to be answered.

name: Cost-diversity payoff
takesLocations: Play one card of each cost; {payoffs} count the different costs in play.

name: Created cards
takesLocations: {enablers} fill your hand with created cards; {payoffs} make them cheaper or reward playing them, so the extra cards win lanes on turns 5 and 6.

name: Skills
takesLocations: {enablers} are skills or add skills to your hand; {payoffs} grow each time you play one, on an otherwise light board.

name: Spend all your Energy
takesLocations: {enablers} soak up the Energy left over each turn; {payoffs} grow every turn you spend it all or play several cards.

name: Power gains (Empower)
takesLocations: {enablers} give your cards Power; {payoffs} add more to every card whose Power was increased.

name: Deck and hand attack
takesLocations: {enablers} remove or weaken the opponent's key cards before they are played; {payoffs} profit from what is left.
